conclusion: All three desktop browser runtimes directly read the anonymous guest token and full public metadata, including 502/502 entries over six pages of size 100. Limit 100 is therefore a verified page size, not an overall import cap. Chrome/Firefox/WebKit success does not establish a physical installed mobile PWA result. A missing playlist returns HTTP 200 with playlistV2.__typename=NotFound; private playlist behavior lacks a known fixture.
